heading: About
Farm Elkana
hero.subheading: A story of heritage, hospitality, and the untamed beauty of Namibia.

paragraphs: Farm Elkana honors Namibia's rich cultural heritage while offering world-class hospitality. Our lodge combines traditional architecture with contemporary luxury, creating an authentic sanctuary in the heart of Africa's most dramatic landscapes.

Nestled in the rolling hills of the Namibian highlands, Farm Elkana has been a family-owned retreat for generations. What began as a working farm has evolved into an exclusive lodge that celebrates the land, its wildlife, and the traditions that have shaped this extraordinary place.
Our commitment to sustainable tourism means every aspect of your stay — from locally sourced cuisine to solar-powered amenities — respects and preserves the environment for future generations.

values.title: Heritage
values.description: Rooted in generations of Namibian farming tradition, we honor the land and its stories through every detail of your stay.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: Solar power, water conservation, and locally sourced materials ensure our luxury treads lightly on this precious landscape.

values.title: Privacy
values.description: As an exclusive-use lodge, Farm Elkana is entirely yours during your stay — no shared spaces, no strangers.
